copy.title: Red Tape Run
copy.tagline: Dodge the procedural abuse. Grab the reforms. Get kids a fair shot.
howTo: Run the family-court gauntlet — tap or press Space to jump.
Jump over the procedural abuses; each hit chips your integrity.
Stay on the ground to grab reforms — accountability and transparency.
Spam-jump and you miss the reforms; never jump and the abuses grind you down.
endLines: Dodge the abuse, pick up the reforms.
Accountability and transparency get kids a fair hearing.
copy.shareText: I dodged the procedural abuse and grabbed the reforms in Red Tape Run — accountability for family courts. Beat my score.
